gpt-6-astra.notes: global standard (pay-as-you-go), short-context rates. azure pricing page still shows placeholders for gpt-6 and points to the blog. cache writes are billed separately at $12.50/1M. long-context requests: $20 input / $2 cached / $25 cache write / $75 output; threshold not stated on any official page checked (third parties say >272k input tokens, whole request). us data zone is +10% ($11/$1.10/$55), eu data zone is +20% ($12/$1.20/$60). reasoning tokens bill as output (learn.microsoft.com reasoning doc). no per-token difference by reasoning effort; medium just changes how many tokens get spent. no per-request minimum found. context window 1,050,000 (922k in / 128k out). openai direct api matches: $10 / $1 / $50 standard.
